environment.description: AWS Lambda function deployed with Function URL configured with AuthType=AWS_IAM. The function's resource-based policy contains a principal condition restricting invoke access to roles matching 'arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT:role/OrderService-*' only. Note: the IAM auth enforcement happens at the Lambda service layer BEFORE the function code executes - requests without valid SigV4 signatures from permitted principals receive a 403 from the Lambda service itself and the handler code never runs. Additionally, the VPC security group on the Lambda ENI restricts egress to the RDS instance on port 5432 only. CloudWatch Logs Insights query monitors for anomalous invocation patterns but this is detective only.
